flagged.evidence: The title says “Compact locally CAT(1) spaces,” but the Statement requires X to be “compact, geodesic and locally CAT(1).” Definition (3) makes local CAT(1) a pointwise closed-ball condition. The two-point metric space with distance 1 is compact and locally CAT(1), since radius-1/3 closed balls are singletons; it contains no circle but is not CAT(1), because its distinct points are not joined by a geodesic. Thus the omitted geodesic hypothesis is essential to the title’s claim.
